EnemyAI._provenance_warning: This file is the CORE RULES enemy AI and nothing else. Until Sep 2026 it held the COMPENDIUM pp.42-43 'AI Variations' base conditions and 1D6 tables — a faithful extraction of the WRONG BOOK — and every consumer showed them at every tier, DLC or not, while the core rules (seven diceless bullet routines, p.42: 'The default AI is diceless') appeared nowhere in the app. The Compendium option lives in data/compendium/difficulty_toggles.json under 'ai_variation_tables' / 'ai_variation_rules' and is gated on ContentFlag.AI_VARIATIONS. Do NOT add dice, base conditions or behaviour tables to this file.
EnemyAI.text: Core Rules p.42: "The way the enemy moves on the field requires the player to inject a modest amount of 'artificial intelligence' into proceedings. It is assumed that the player will make decisions based on what is reasonable, but can also operate enemies according to one of seven broad AI types, shown below. It is up to the player to decide how strictly to adhere to these."

content.title: AI Types
content.description: Seven broad AI types (Core Rules pp.42-43). The default AI is diceless — the player follows the bullets for the type in question.

types.name: Aggressive
types.description: Advances on opponents in sight and tries to reach a Brawl.
core_rules: Aggressive enemies with opponents in sight will advance at least half a move towards them, attempting to remain in Cover if possible.
Enemies that are unable to see any opposition, or which are within 12", will advance as fast as possible towards the nearest opponent, attempting to enter into a Brawl.
They will not enter a Brawl with an opponent that has higher Combat Skill.
Heavy weapon figures will not move if they have a Line of Sight to a target.

types.name: Cautious
types.description: Stays in Cover, fights at long range and avoids Brawling.
core_rules: Cautious enemies will attempt to stay in Cover whenever possible.

Figures with an opponent in sight and range will remain where they are and take Aimed shots. Otherwise, they will advance in or behind terrain features, trying to establish Line of Sight to opposing figures.
They will attempt to engage targets at as close to maximum range as possible, and will not advance voluntarily within 12" of opposition.
As a general rule, they will not enter Brawling combat.

types.name: Tactical
types.description: Advances under Cover, outflanks, and stays near friendly figures.
core_rules: Tactical enemies will advance at half speed, always retaining Cover where possible. They will cross open ground at full speed, if needed.
They will attempt to close to within 12" of their opponents, then will move to outflank and get clear Line of Sight where possible.
If, within one move, they can attempt to Brawl possessing higher Combat Skill, they will; otherwise they will fire.
If they have a clear shot and are in Cover, they will remain in place to Aim.
Tactical enemies will attempt to remain within 3" of a friendly figure whenever possible.

types.name: Defensive
types.description: Holds its own half of the table, fires from Cover, reinforces neighbours.
core_rules: Defensive enemies will advance to weapons range, but will remain in their initial half of the table, and will remain in Cover or behind terrain whenever possible.
Once in position, they will fire from those positions, standing still to Aim, and will move to Brawl if opponents enter their terrain features and they have equal or better Combat Skill.
If a terrain feature with friendlies has been entered by the player's forces, those within adjacent features will move to reinforce.

types.name: Rampage
types.description: Charges the closest opponent and always tries to Brawl.
core_rules: Rampaging enemies will move as fast as possible towards the closest opponent, and will always attempt to enter Brawling combat.
Rampagers with Heavy weapons will stand still and fire, if in sight of a target.

types.name: Beast
types.description: Closes as far as Cover allows and hunts in packs.
core_rules: Beast enemies will always attempt to move as far as possible towards the nearest opponent, while remaining in Cover.
They will only break Cover if they can enter a Brawl within two moves. Otherwise they will move to break Line of Sight and maneuver closer.
When possible, Beasts will attempt to remain within 2" of a friendly figure, attacking the same targets.

types.name: Guardian
types.description: Attached to another figure and mirrors everything it does.
core_rules: Guardian enemies are attached to another figure, and must always remain within 3" of that figure, if possible.
They will move at the same pace and attack the same targets using the same methods (firing / Brawling), whenever possible.
